title: Try an e-mail
intro: See a template's exact e-mail, in the language and width you choose. It is the same text and the same design it leaves with: nothing is sent to anyone, and the buttons of templates with a one-use link show a sample address.
subject: Subject
queued: Done: the test is in the queue, to your own account, in {language}. It leaves under the usual sending rules.
alreadyQueued: That test was already in the queue.
notThisOne: This e-mail carries a one-use link: you can view it, but it is not sent as a test.
limit: You have asked for the most tests allowed this hour. Try again later.
failed: The test could not be requested. Try again.
limitNote: Up to 5 tests an hour, always to your own account. Each one is recorded in the activity log.
unavailable: This e-mail cannot be drawn right now.
